COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
02.09.2024 CRLR No. 603 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
The proposed Revision has been filed 
challenging the judgment dated 
18.10.2023, passed by learned Judge, 
Family Court, Dehradun in Criminal Case 
No. 331 of 2020, by which, the learned 
Judge has directed the proposed revisionist 
to pay Rs. 10,000/-(Rupees ten thousand)
per month for the maintenance of his wife, 
the respondent, under Section 125 of the 
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
2. Heard Mr. Vishwast Kandpal, learned 
counsel for the proposed revisionist. 
3. The proposed Revision has been filed 
along with an Application under Section 5 of 
the Limitation Act, 1963 to condone the 
delay of 225 days.
4. The proposed revisionist is directed to 
file a copy of the petition, filed by him for 
Haq-e-zaujiyat.
5. List on 15.10.2024.
6. It is clarified that this Court has not 
passed any interim order/stay order in the 
present matter. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 02.09.2024

(Stay Appl. No.02 of 2024)
In
CRLR No.603 of 2024
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vishwast Kandpal, learned counsel for 
the Revisionist. 
2. No representation for the respondent. 
3. Heard on delay condonation application.
4. There is delay of 225 days in filing the 
instant revision. The grounds shown in the 
affidavit filed in support of delay condonation 
application are sufficient to allow the delay 
condonation application. The delay is condoned
subject to the condition that revisionist shall 
deposit a sum of Rs.1,000/- to be deposited in the 
Advocates’ Welfare Fund High Court Bar 
Association. Accordingly, delay condonation 
application is allowed.
5. Admit.
6. Counter affidavit, if any, be filed by the 
respondent within three weeks. 
7. As an interim measure till the next date of 
listing effect and operation of impugned judgment 
and order dated 18.10.2023 passed by learned 
Judge, Family Court, Dehradun in Misc. Criminal 
Case No.331 of 2020 shall remain stayed subject 
to the condition that revisionist shall pay 50% of 
the arrear amount to the respondent. 
8. List on 22.12.2025. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 27.10.2025
